data.one_liner: An advanced segment widget with full customization support and drag gestures.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable segment control widget for Flutter. It supports text styles, layout decoration, gradients, custom sliders, shadows, and drag gestures.
use_when: You need a segmented control widget to switch between different views or options.
You want to fully customize the appearance of the segment layout and the slider thumb using gradients, borders, or custom decorations.
avoid_when: You require native platform-styled segment controls like Cupertino segmented control out of the box without manual styling.
You need complex form builder integration rather than a standalone selection widget.
strengths: Highly customizable through decoration parameters, gradients, and custom slider decorations.
Supports drag gestures for switching segments.
Generic types support for segment keys.
weaknesses: Recent versions include breaking changes like the replacement of background color and border radius parameters with a unified decoration parameter.
